name: sistema-monarca
description: Sistema Monarca - Panel de Control, Productividad y Progresión Personal

scripts.prepare-web: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('www')) fs.mkdirSync('www'); fs.copyFileSync('index.html','www/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('style.css','www/style.css'); if(fs.existsSync('manifest.json')) fs.copyFileSync('manifest.json','www/manifest.json'); if(fs.existsSync('sw.js')) fs.copyFileSync('sw.js','www/sw.js'); if(fs.existsSync('app.js')) fs.copyFileSync('app.js','www/app.js'); const cpDir=(src,dest)=>{ if(!fs.existsSync(dest)) fs.mkdirSync(dest, {recursive:true}); fs.readdirSync(src).forEach(file=>{ const s=src+'/'+file, d=dest+'/'+file; if(fs.lstatSync(s).isDirectory()) cpDir(s,d); else fs.copyFileSync(s,d); }); }; if(fs.existsSync('js')) cpDir('js','www/js'); if(fs.existsSync('icons')) cpDir('icons','www/icons'); console.log('Assets copiados a www/ con éxito');"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run prepare-web && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:build: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
